about_the_game:
《Modern City Cultivation Saga》is an open world sandbox cultivation game set in modern cities of the 21st century. It is based on Chinese cultivation culture and ghost legends. You can start the game with various characters of different identities, experience the process of gradually cultivating from a mortal to become a peak powerhouse, or silently experience the vicissitudes of life. You can choose according to your heart.

You can play the role of an ordinary person in the city
You can play the role of a waste who lives another life
You can play the role of the doorstep in distress - son-in-law
You can play the role of a grandson who inherits feng shui
You can play the role of a disciple of the Hidden Sect
You can play the role of a reincarnated immortal
You can play the protagonist of the novel plot (MOD)


In modern cities of the 21st century, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth has long been depleted, resources are scarce, martial arts are lost, and spiritual objects are extinct. People generally believe that cultivating truth and becoming immortal has become a legend, and technology has replaced everything. People no longer believe in the existence of immortal methods.
However, this is only a superficial phenomenon.
In fact, throughout history, there have still been some immortal sects and sects that have survived. They hide outside the world, some do not care about the affairs of the world, while others hide behind the scenes and manipulate the world.
Recently, various mysterious and strange events have occurred around the world, and people have begun to feel that the world is far from being as simple as they imagined.
Your story unfolds slowly against this backdrop.
How will you find your own path in the secular world?
How will you use your abilities to influence the world?
Now, I am looking forward to your journey on the immortal path!
Let's start together!



【 World Differences 】 ----

Compared with the traditional cultivation game world, the things of the times are different, and the realm also pays more attention to the growth process of the four realms of Qi refining, Foundation building, Golden Elixir, and Yuanying in the early stage. In the era of technology and hot weapons, whether the cultivator's skills can still traverse the world, we look forward to you experiencing it.

【World Formation】 ----

Each game world is randomly generated by the system at the beginning, including world maps, cities, and techniquesNPC、Secret realms, techniques, powers, sects, and more provide you with a unique gaming experience every time you play.

【World Live】 ----

In the early stages of the game, if you still lack abilities, in order to survive and integrate into society, you can earn income through various jobs and tasks, as well as learn from various places, gradually improving your abilities. In the middle stage, you can enhance your abilities through cultivation, magic weapons, and battles. In the later stage, you can control your power and collect endless genius treasures to cleanse and break through your own limits. Each stage allows you to experience different paths of cultivation.

【World Exploration】 ----

In this free and open world, you can explore various urban legends, secret events, mountain and sea myths, personal adventures, etc., thus changing the development pattern of the world.

【World Conquer】 ----

What does the cultivation of immortality rely on?It is a resource. Climbing to the peak of the immortal path requires starting from endless resources, conquering powerful families and hermit sects around the world, in order to obtain manpower, wealth, elixirs, and treasures for oneself. It is the fastest way.

【World Change】 ----

The game world will evolve on its own with the flow of time. Time operates according to a 24-hour mechanism every day, and characters and things around the world are quietly changing. The Great Way is ruthless, and the world is full of vicissitudes. Whether you pursue the Great Way with your loved ones or face the ups and downs of life with a more peaceful attitude and respect for the laws of all things depends entirely on you.

【World Challenge】 ----

In this world, there are various NPCs who are driving the evolution of the world with different identities, personalities, abilities, purposes, good and evil, preferences, and other factors. There are ordinary citizens, powerful families, and hidden sects that control the world behind them. There are also many talented sons of heaven who, like the protagonist, are exploring this world with the intention of changing and conquering it. You can compete with them or avoid their sharpness.

【World Purpose】 ----

In the game, every year the spiritual energy of heaven and earth resurrects by 1. If you don't do anything, you can also welcome the final plot of the game 1000 years later.You can also accelerate the evolution of the world, gradually explore various events and open up secret realms, release and improve the spiritual energy of heaven and earth. The higher the spiritual energy, the more beneficial it is to cultivate and grow, but there will also be more powerful monsters and experts. When the spiritual energy level reaches a certain level, it will trigger the main quest. When the spiritual energy of heaven and earth is full, it will trigger the final plot. External immortals will revive due to their strong spiritual energy, break through the defense seal network, invade the Blue Star, and you can choose to lead your followers to the final ultimate battle, or continue to live peacefully and pursue the supreme immortal path. The game emphasizes free evolution and does not force you to play how to play.





【MOD Support】 ----

In the future, MOD development support will gradually be provided. You can create some cultivation stories and characters that you like into the game, and share them with everyone to play. Let's build a rich and exciting cultivation world together.

【DLC Expansion】 ----

We are very passionate about games with cultivation themes. Although we are not doing well enough at present, we will strive to make it a classic. This is our original intention in making this game, so we will continue to develop and improve it in the future. As long as there are still people who support and like it, we sincerely listen to your suggestions and try our best to make cultivation games that you love.





If you have any opinions, ideas or creativity that you would like to provide to the production team, please feel free to join the official QQ communication group to offer your valuable ideas!
